page.notes: Long s is transcribed as s throughout. "ges-si" in the first verse line is read from a worn, ligatured form and is doubtful. The Hebrew-free, Greek-free page has no reference marks or margin notes. The line "Fili mi ... sapientia mea" was read from the page; the word "sapientiam" in the first line is printed "sapientia" in the scan. The paragraph ending "exi-" continues on the next page.
